title: Aaryavir Sehwag's 160 Powers India U19 Past UAE Into Asia Cup Semis
excerpt: The opener's 160 off 168 balls, a 193-run stand with VK Vineeth and Ishan Sood's four wickets sealed a 70-run win in Al Amerat and a semi-final against Afghanistan on November 12.
body:
• Aaryavir Sehwag scored 160 off 168 balls as India U19 beat the UAE by 70 runs in Al Amerat on Tuesday to reach the U19 Asia Cup semi-finals.
  • India posted 309 for 7 — Sehwag shared a 193-run second-wicket stand with VK Vineeth, who made 67 — and bowled the UAE out for 239, with Ishan Sood taking 4 for 37.
  • Sehwag, named Player of the Match, said he had promised his father, former India opener Virender Sehwag, a big hundred before the game.
  • India face Afghanistan in the semi-final on Thursday, November 12; Pakistan play Bangladesh in the other semi-final.

Aaryavir Sehwag's 160 off 168 balls carried India Under-19 to a 70-run win over the United Arab Emirates at Al Amerat in Oman on Tuesday, sealing a place in the ACC Men's U19 Asia Cup semi-finals. India posted 309 for 7, the highest team total of the tournament so far, and bowled the UAE out for 239 in 49.6 overs, according to NewKerala's report of the match.

An Innings Built, Then Unleashed

The opener, son of former India batter Virender Sehwag, took 14 balls to get off the mark before reaching his century off 131 balls, then added 60 runs off his last 37 deliveries. He struck 17 fours and seven sixes in all. His 193-run second-wicket partnership with VK Vineeth, who scored 67 off 69 balls, took India to 255 for 1 by the 45th over before a late slide — six wickets for 54 runs — closed the innings at 309 for 7, IANS reported. Naseem Khan took four wickets for the UAE.

"I promised my dad a big hundred."

— Aaryavir Sehwag, after the match

Sehwag said after the game that he had promised his father a big hundred ahead of the match, and that he was determined to bat deep on a turning wicket at the Al Amerat Cricket Ground. It was his maiden century for India U19, following a 70 against Nepal earlier in the tournament, and the highest individual score of this Asia Cup so far. He was named Player of the Match.

Sood Finishes the Job

The UAE chase rested on Ahmed Khudadad's 74 off 74 balls and a late 39 off 25 from Noorullah Ayobi, but Ishan Sood's 4 for 37 kept India in control, and the UAE were dismissed for 239. The win completed a recovery for the Lakshya Raichandani-led side, which had lost its group game to Pakistan by three wickets before beating Nepal and the UAE.

What It Means

India, eight-time champions, now face Afghanistan in the semi-final on Thursday, November 12, at Al Amerat; Afghanistan beat Sri Lanka by 106 runs in the group stage. Defending champions Pakistan take on Bangladesh in the other semi-final, with the final on November 14. For readers in the United States, the semi-final falls on Thursday morning India time — the latest step in a tournament that has so far belonged to one innings: a Sehwag hundred, promised in advance and delivered at a run a ball's pace after a scoreless start.
